The Senior Integrated Marketing Manager is part of the core team responsible for leading the strategy, development, and execution of integrated, multi-channel marketing programs that drive brand growth, demand generation, and revenue impact across assigned global Operating Unit. 

This role operates as a strategic marketing partner to senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Strategy, owning end-to-end campaign planning and execution across global markets. The role translates business priorities into scalable marketing strategies and high-impact campaigns, ensuring alignment with go-to-market plans and commercial objectives. 

Reporting into the Marketing leader for the global operating unit, working as part of a core global marketing team aligned to the OU, This role will predominantly be focused on driving pipeline growth in assigned region via execution of marketing programmes through working closely with centralized MBC teams such as comms, analyst relations, events, content, creative, analytics, digital media and operations.

lists.content:
• Lead the development of integrated global marketing strategies and plans aligned to business and revenue objectives for the assigned Operating Unit(s).

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders, shaping go-to-market and demand generation approaches.

  • Own campaign prioritization and planning across segments, industries, and geographies, ensuring alignment with commercial targets and growth opportunities.

  • Own responsibility for marketing contribution to pipeline, demand generation targets, and campaign ROI.

  • Establish KPIs, measurement frameworks, and reporting structures to track performance and business impact, working with the Marketing Analytics team.

  • Translate campaign and pipeline performance into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous optimization. 

  • Drive the execution of campaigns and activities through collaboration and alignment with the responsible cross-functional teams including marketing operations, digital, analytics, content, communications, and events, ensuring seamless execution.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing to lead go-to-market planning, product launches, and sales enablement initiatives.

  • Ensure strong governance of campaign processes, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, processes, and tools.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends, marketing technologies, and competitive activity to inform strategy.

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior marketing team members.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or related field with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience

  • Desired experience within the industry relevant to the OU

  • At least 8 years’ experience in B2B marketing, with significant experience leading integrated marketing strategy and execution.

  • Proven track record of owning and delivering global, multi-channel campaigns with measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong experience in strategic planning, campaign orchestration, and stakeholder management at senior levels.

  • Advanced analytical skills with experience interpreting data into strategic insights and business decisions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level engagement.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage complex, concurrent programs.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

This role is responsible for interpreting and defining client needs in order to align the client’s objectives and requirements with Dun & Bradstreet’s data, capabilities and value. Articulating how our data in conjunction with key partner technologies can lead to strong business outcomes is key.

In this role, you will work in partnership with the Relationship Manager, Solution Sales, Solution Architects and Client Success team, advise on our integrated proposition, including lakehouses and agentic workflows, and display a willingness to learn about and develop relationships with our strategic partners. This will include supporting the Relationship Manager in web-based meetings, in-person meetings, and through providing collateral and thought leadership to support driving Cross Sell, Upsell and New Business.

lists.content:
• Fulfil the role of trusted advisor on Dun & Bradstreet data through strategic conversations to understand organizational business objectives and goals.
  • Actively participate in the evaluation stage of the sales process and serve as the technical advisor for Dun & Bradstreet’s dataset.
  • Assist with client facing demonstrations by clearly articulating underlying methodologies, while providing guidance on how the product functionality helps to improve organizational efficiencies.
  • Actively participate in account planning for assigned accounts, provide industry trends and assist with client/market segmentation of Dun & Bradstreet’s products.
  • Support or lead outbound thought leadership in the form of White Papers, Webinars, Events, Expert Panels etc.
  • To maintain a detailed knowledge of key partner technology, success criteria, and market approach.
  • Maintain and grow revenue stream through successful interpreting and defining client needs in order to align the client’s objectives and business requirements with Dun & Bradstreet’s products’ capabilities and value
  • Support sellers in effectively packaging, pricing and presenting solutions to clients including return on investment.
  • Work in close partnership with strategic partners to develop opportunities for new sales, cross sell & upsell, and migration to new delivery mechanisms
  • Maintain consistent and accurate data in relevant CRM software (e.g. SFDC) and other sales tools to support territory, account planning and forecasting.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

• At least 5 years’ senior sales/consulting experience in technology and/or data where you have successfully and consistently over delivered against targets
  • Minimum of 3 years customer facing new business sales experience. 
  • Adept at providing technical solutions based on clients’ needs per the practice area
  • Customer centric with a proactive attitude to tackle problems and deliver solutions for great customer experience during the whole customer journey
  • High aptitude to stay current and train on related technology areas
  • Compliance with industry professional certifications is required when selling specific regulated financial or data products
  • Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., SFDC) and Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Understanding of Cloud Lakehouses, Hyperscalers, & AI Assistants.
  • An informed point of view on Big Data, Analytics and AI
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

The Senior Manager, Events & Experiences is responsible for leading the strategy and execution of D&B’s owned event portfolio, including customer-facing programs (roundtables, advisory boards, conferences, and webinars) and high-touch internal executive experiences. This role translates enterprise event strategy into high-impact programs that deepen customer engagement, strengthen executive relationships, and support business priorities.

The role leads a small team and ensures consistent delivery of elevated, “white-glove” experiences across internal and external audiences.

lists.content:
• Lead the planning and execution of D&B’s owned event portfolio, including: customer roundtables and executive dinners, Customer Advisory Boards, Proprietary conferences and hosted events, and virtual events and webinars.

  • Translate enterprise events and experiential strategy into scalable, repeatable programs that drive engagement, pipeline, and customer insights.

  • Partner with marketing, product, and sales leadership to align owned event programs to key audiences, verticals, and business priorities.

  • Own the design and delivery of high-touch internal and executive events, including: Sales Kickoffs and CEO Circle and Executive Meetings.

  • Ensure all internal experiences reflect a premium, white-glove standard, elevating executive engagement, storytelling, and brand perception.

  • Partner with executive stakeholders, communications, and People team to align messaging, experience design, and outcomes.

  • Manage and develop a small, high-performing team, driving accountability, collaboration, and growth.

  • Lead end-to-end execution across owned and internal event programs, including: agenda and content development, experience design, vendor and production management, logistics, and budget tracking.

  • Establish and maintain high standards for execution, attendee experience, and operational rigor across all programs - and define and track success metrics.

• Bachelor's degree in marketing or a related field; Master's preferred.

  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience in event marketing, experiential programs, or event operations within a B2B of fast paced environment, with prior leadership experience.

  • Proven experience managing owned events and executive-level experiences, including both in-person and virtual formats

  •  Strong ability to design and deliver high-touch, premium experiences for senior audiences

  • Experience working directly with executive stakeholders and leadership teams, with strong stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills across cross-functional and global teams

  • Ability to translate strategic priorities into well-executed, high-impact programs

  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously

  • Strong business acumen and understanding of how events drive customer engagement, pipeline, and retention

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

  • Willingness to travel and support events outside standard business hours as required

• Ability to sit, speak and operate telephone and/or computer for long periods of time

  • Ability to handle pressure, stressful conditions, and conflict resolution

  • Willingness to work non‑standard hours, including evenings or occasional weekends, to support global time zones

  • Ability to travel by any form of transportation; 50-60% global travel required

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, kneel, crouch and bend over for work at office premises and office events

  • Regular attendance in the office; Hybrid role: 2–3 days in the office requirement

  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex data and business topics into clear, compelling narratives for diverse external audiences.

  • Operate at the tactical and strategic level, engaging stakeholders across the enterprise to drive results.
  • Use incident response operational data to drive decisions regarding resource allocation, threat mitigation, and analyst development.
  • Collaborate with Incident Response and Security Operations Center leaders to deliver continuous monitoring and response capabilities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.
  • Provide front-line coordination and people leadership to IR/SOC analysts.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in Security Operations or Incident Response. Preferably 6+ years in conducting cyber investigations using security and infrastructure technologies, working with Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems, and 4+ years people management experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience in managing or monitoring GCP, AWS, or Azure environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a high energy, high growth, fast paced, entrepreneurial environment. Willing to learn new skills and implement new technologies
  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and the able to work independently with minimal supervision

The Senior Manager, Quote to Cash leads quote-to-cash product and process enhancements for assigned region, balancing competing priorities across product and sales teams while coordinating  closely with the Virtual Back Office (VBO) usage metering system. This role provides leadership to resources supporting the Configure, Price, and Contract Management workstreams and is accountable for resolving financial issues and discrepancies between systems.

lists.content:
• Accountable for the planning and design of assigned region’s quote-to-cash enhancements, including product design, process optimization, and automated entitlement improvements. Optimize CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) and CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) design for international roll-out.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate product, pricing, and revenue requirements into scalable CPQ. Provide leadership to the CPQ and CLM teams by establishing and promoting best practices in product design. 

  • Oversee and resolve accounting alignment across order management and revenue systems, including sales, billing, and revenue recognition. Ensure accurate financial reporting through close collaboration with the accounting team.

  • Collaborate with integration stakeholders (e.g., VBO, Workday, Sales and Revenue Engine (SRE)) to identify root causes of system failures and drive process improvements to enhance stability and performance. 

  • Develop reports for product and sales to drive forecasting and insights into the product. 

  • Actively coach and develop team members for performance management and personal/career growth in line with the values, expectations and culture of D&B.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related fields

  • At least 10 years of experience in quota-to-cash, specifically with Revenue Cloud systems, preferably with 5 years at managerial capacity

  • Hands on experience configuring and maintaining CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) solutions by translating pricing, packaging, and financial requirements into system functionality within both custom-built and commercial software platforms
  • Experience performing financial reconciliations and matching data across multiple systems resolving discrepancies

  • Deep understanding of accounting and controls

  • Be adaptive to changes in fast-paced environment; Strong attention to detail, as well as being a problem solver who takes the initiative

  • Good communications skills with different levels

  • Analytical, result-oriented and organized

  • Be independent and flexible with strong business acumen

  • Able to work under pressure and tight schedules, willing to work outside normal working hours during close periods

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of  driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

  • Willingness to travel and support events outside standard business hours as required

• Ability to sit, speak and operate telephone and/or computer for long periods of time

  • Ability to handle pressure, stressful conditions, and conflict resolution

  • Ability to work day, evening and/or weekend hours as needed

  • Ability to travel by any form of transportation

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, kneel, crouch and bend over for work at office premises and office events

  • Regular attendance in the office 

    •  
     
    #LI-DNI

The Senior Network Engineer serves as a technical leader in the design, implementation, and optimization of our enterprise and cloud network infrastructure. This role partners closely with Technology leadership, engineers, and end users to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing network solutions with a strong focus on AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

lists.content:
• Define cloud network requirements, establish architecture, and create detailed designs and standards that meet business goals.
  • Manage and support LAN/WAN implementations and configurations, including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, voice, and video solutions.
  • Provide leadership in managing network infrastructure and related support organizations, including MSPs, cloud providers, and communications vendors.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and problem resolution; provide recommendations, build consensus, and execute solutions.
  • Recommend appropriate courses of action to network infrastructure engineers, NOC, MSPs, and IT management on technical and operational issues

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in network engineering
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise-level cloud architecture with a focus on network design and
    implementation (AWS and GCP, with a focus on GCP).
  • Networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent is preferred
  • Expert knowledge of network infrastructure, protocols, and standards; VPN access; firewalls;
    proxies; and other security appliances and solutions.
  • Thorough knowledge of Cisco routers and switches, HSRP, GLBP, VSS, multi-VRF, BGP, MPLS,
    OSPF, TCP/IP, DNS, NTP, SNMP, Cisco wireless (WLC & ISE), and Windows networking.
  • Experience deploying and managing AWS VPCs and Direct Connect and enterprise-level GCP
    VPCs.
  • Experience with high-level programming languages such as Python or Java, or familiarity with
    Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
  • Experience using Ansible to automate network configuration standardization.
  • Understanding of NOC operations and the ability to manage day-to-day incidents and problem
    resolution.
  • Experience implementing proactive network management and monitoring solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of business environments, network and security infrastructure, and supported
    services.
  • Strong problem management skills, including risk identification, assessment, and corrective action
    planning.
  • Leadership ability to create vision, scope, and plans for future network and security infrastructure
    requirements.
  • Ablility to translate business and product needs into resilient technical solutions.
  • Self-motivated with ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Experience managing multiple vendors, reviewing new features, and negotiating as needed.
  • Ability to lead network deliverables and provide technical leadership and cross-training to less
    experienced engineers.
  • Ability to participate in a support rotation schedule, including weekends, to support the
    organization’s technologies and infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be
    inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and
    teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with
    stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies
    through structural courses and programs.
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

The Senior O365 Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, and support of Microsoft 365 services across the enterprise, with deep experience spanning the full Microsoft platform. This role delivers and maintains identity, security, and collaboration solutions including single sign-on (SSO) applications, app registrations, conditional access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Microsoft Purview, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Microsoft 365 Groups, Exchange, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Work includes configuring secure access controls, governing data and collaboration workloads, and automating administration through PowerShell and scripting. You will support service health, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance across Microsoft 365 workloads while partnering with security, infrastructure, and business teams. Through strong platform stewardship and cross-platform expertise, the engineer contributes to a secure, well-governed, and highly available Microsoft 365 environment.

lists.content:
• Administer, support, and maintain Microsoft 365 services across the platform, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 Groups. 
  • Configure and manage single sign-on (SSO) applications, app registrations, and enterprise application integrations in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory).  
  • Design, implement, and maintain conditional access policies to secure identity and enforce access controls across the environment. 
  • Administer privileged access using Privileged Identity Management (PIM), including just-in-time activation of privileged roles, eligible role assignments, and periodic privileged-access reviews.  
  • Apply data governance, security, and compliance controls using Microsoft Purview, including data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and retention policies.  
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate provisioning, administration, reporting, and routine operational tasks across Microsoft 365 workloads.  
  • Administer SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams, including site collections, permissions, sharing and external-access policies, governance, and lifecycle management.  
  • Support Exchange Online configuration, including mail flow, connectors, distribution groups, and messaging and compliance policies.  
  • Manage Microsoft 365 Groups and identity lifecycle, including provisioning, membership, and periodic access reviews. 
  • Monitor service health, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance across Microsoft 365 and the broader Microsoft platform. 
  • Support the deployment, configuration, governance, and adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, including licensing, data-access readiness, and security and compliance controls. 
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and business teams to align Microsoft 365 configurations with organizational, security, and end-user needs.

• Experience across all Microsoft platforms, with hands-on administration of Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft 365 Groups).
  • Hands-on experience with single sign-on (SSO) applications, app registrations, and enterprise application integration in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory).
  • Experience configuring and managing conditional access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM) roles, and identity and access controls.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview governance features and related security and compliance controls, including data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and retention.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and scripting to automate administration, provisioning, and reporting across Microsoft 365.
  • Experience administering SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Groups, and Exchange Online.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment, governance, licensing, and adoption, including data-access and security readiness.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for endpoint and device management is a plus (optional).
  • Ability to collaborate across technical functions and communicate clearly with partners.
  • Certifications such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator) and SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) are preferred. Additional certifications including MS-700, SC-400, SC-900, AZ-104 and AZ-900 are beneficial.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience with platform performance optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

The Senior Product Manager will lead the strategy, development, and management of AI-native products within our portfolio. This role involves driving product vision, market analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver innovative solutions that meet customer needs and align with business goals.

The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for overseeing the product lifecycle from ideation through to launch and beyond, ensuring the product’s success in the market.

lists.content:
• Product management function participates in the development of document specifications that outline revisions or additional features of existing products, and the conception of new products.
  • Completes market research to identify trends and/or needs of targeted clients/customers. Analyzes and compares competitor's product lines in relation to the organization's current offerings. 
  • Develop strategies for competitive positioning to increase sales and promotions.
  • Serves as a liaison between other departments to gather client/customer feedback and disseminate information about the status of product development.
  • The ideal candidate will combine strong product leadership with hands-on fluency in AI capabilities and a passion for leveraging trusted data to power intelligent, differentiated solutions.
  • Be a subject matter expert on D&B enterprise AI capabilities and how they can be leveraged to fulfill a specific solution.
  • Develop and maintain a product roadmap that aligns with business goals and customer needs. Manage risks & issues and execute on product build.
  • Manage the product throughout its lifecycle, from ideation to retirement. Prioritize product features and enhancements based on strategic goals. Ensuring continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams including GTM, Technology, Sales, Customer Experience, Solution Architecture, Pricing and Finance to define product requirements and ensure successful development and delivery.
  • Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, ensuring that products meet quality standards, user needs, and expectations.
  • Keep abreast of latest market trends, perform research to understand customers’ needs, industry trends and competition landscape.
  • Lead the product development process, collaborating with engineering, design, and other teams to deliver high-quality products on time.
  • Proactively seeks feedback with sellers on product pipeline ensuring adoption, retention and growth.
  • Create detailed product requirements, user stories, and specifications.
  • Define and track key product metrics to measure product performance, trends, and risks to inform data driven decisions about areas for improvement.
  • Develop business cases for new product initiatives.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior product managers and team members.

• Bachelor’s Degree with major in Business Administration, Technology or related disciplines.

  • At least 8 years’ experience of pre-sales / solutions consulting/ product management/ project management.

  • Strong understanding of market research, competitive analysis, and customer needs assessment.

  • Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

  • Analytical capabilities, results oriented, with proven ability to multitask and prioritize.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skill, with experience in dealing with senior management and all levels including across matrix teams.

  • Independent, detailed oriented, and a good team player.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales and analytics teams.

  • Ability to translate business goals into product requirements.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills.

  • Proficiency in leveraging AI tools and capabilities (e.g., generative AI, copilots, agent frameworks) in day-to-day workflows to enhance productivity, research, and product development.

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

  • Strong background in data, analytics, or technology-led products
  • Ability to translate market insight into clear commercial strategy and results
  • Experience working closely with sales, marketing, and product teams in a cross-functional setting
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into action

lists.content:

  • Develop and continuously refine positioning frameworks, value propositions, and core narratives that articulate differentiated value in a clear, credible, and customer centric way.

descriptionPlain: The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and operability of production systems across our platforms, by applying software engineering practices to operations, with a focus on automation, observability, and incident response.
description: The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and operability of production systems across our platforms, by applying software engineering practices to operations, with a focus on automation, observability, and incident response.

lists.content:
• Own and improve the reliability, availability, and performance of production services in Google Cloud (GCP).
  • Participate in incident management, including detection, triage, mitigation, escalation, and recovery.
  • Use and improve incident workflows and tooling (e.g., ServiceNow) to ensure clear ownership and timely communication.
  • Design, implement, and operate observability solutions including monitoring, logging, tracing, synthetics, and dashboards (e.g., Splunk Observability, OpenTelemetry).
  • Reduce operational toil through automation and engineering-led solutions, proactively introducing and driving SRE best practices.
  • Support on-call rotations across multiple time zones, contributing to a sustainable 24/7 support model.
  • Define, monitor, and report SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
  • Drive and be accountable for best-in-class service availability through SRE principles, automation, and proactive reliability engineering.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
  • Strong experience with cloud-native concepts and technologies, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes (GKE).
  • Proven experience with Site Reliability Engineering and production incident management, ideally using platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools, including metrics, logs, traces, and synthetics (e.g., Splunk Observability, OpenTelemetry).
  • Exposure to reliability testing, resilience engineering, or cost optimisation initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex production issues quickly.
  • Software development or automation experience using Python, shell scripts, or similar languages.
  • Hands-on experience operating production cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience managing multi-region, high-availability production systems with a focus on scalability, resilience, and minimising service disruption during failures.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

lists.content:
• Fulfill the role of trusted advisor on Dun & Bradstreet solutions through strategic conversations to understand organizational business objectives and goals.
  • Working in conjunction with a frontline sales team, actively manage the evaluation stage of the sales process and serve as the technical advisor for Dun & Bradstreet’s product suite.
  • Assist with client facing demonstrations by clearly articulating underlying methodologies, while providing guidance on how the product functionality helps to improve organizational efficiencies.
  • Actively participate in account planning for assigned accounts, provide industry trends and assist with client/market segmentation of Dun & Bradstreet’s products.
  • Capture solution insights based on competitive analysis and client meetings; share insights with internal product teams during product design and development cycles.
  • Mapping out of customer use case journeys, identifying pain points, and proposing solutions by conducting product demonstrations, workshops, and POCs to showcase the capabilities and value of our solutions.
  • Be a respected subject matter expert for assigned solution(s); discuss product strategy and roadmaps in the context of market and technology trends.
  • Demonstrate product capabilities, overcome client objections and create a client specific buying vision.
  • Maintain and grow revenue stream through successful interpreting and defining client needs to align the client’s objectives and business requirements with Dun & Bradstreet’s products’ capabilities and value.
  • Support sellers in effectively packaging, pricing and presenting solutions to clients including return on investment.
  • Maintain consistent and accurate data in relevant CRM software (e.g. SFDC) and other sales tools to support territory, account planning and forecasting.
  • Ensure compliance with all business initiatives.
  • Serve as a thought leader in the industry, staying up-to-date with market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote D&B's offerings.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

• Minimum of five (5) years prior experience in customer facing Field sales role selling new solutions to clients and generating significant revenue growth.
  • Customer centric with a proactive attitude to tackle problems and deliver solutions for great customer experience at scale for large companies during the whole customer journey
  • Getting information on client’s decision criteria and executing tailored activities to meet them
  • Experienced communicator when managing customers at different organisational levels.
  • High aptitude to stay current and train on related technology areas
  • Adept at providing technical solutions based on clients’ needs per the practice area
  • Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., SFDC) and Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Compliance with industry professional certifications is required when selling specific regulated financial or data products
  • Able and willing to mentor and support other members of the team
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

    Fluency in English and Norwegian is required for this role

lists.content:
• Own day-to-day management of social media channels, ensuring consistent publishing aligned with content calendars

  • Develop and refine social media content, including campaign posts, thought leadership, and corporate communications

  • Coach Social Media Analysts, providing day-to-day direction, feedback, and professional growth opportunities to ensure high-quality execution and continuous improvement.

  • Adapt content effectively across platforms to maximize engagement and audience reach

  • Ensure all social media output aligns with brand voice, tone, and editorial standards

  • Execute integrated social media campaigns in collaboration with Corporate Communications and Marketing teams

  • Contribute to content planning and campaign ideation, bringing forward creative ideas and storytelling approaches

  • Support delivery of key initiatives such as product launches, campaigns, and corporate announcements

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to gather content inputs and align on messaging priorities

  • Work with external agencies or vendors to support content production and delivery

  • Provide guidance to internal teams on social media best practices and platform requirements

  • Monitor social media performance and track key metrics such as engagement, reach, and impressions

  • Analyze campaign and channel performance to generate actionable insights

  • Optimize content, timing, and format based on performance data and audience behavior

  • Support development of performance reports and dashboards

  • Monitor social media channels for comments, mentions, and emerging conversations

  • Apply social media tools and best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in social media, corporate communications, marketing, or public relations, preferably in a global, B2B, technology, or data-driven environment.

  • Experience managing social media channels and executing multi-platform campaigns

lists.text: What’s on Offer at D&B Ireland
lists.content:
• 25 days annual leave (plus 2 paid volunteer days & 1 paid un-sick day)
  • Holiday buy & sell (the option to buy or sell up to 5 additional days per year)
  • Flexible working - hybrid model
  • Employee Health Insurance
  • Mental Health Support program
  • Pension Contribution
  • Family Friendly Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Parental, Marriage and Bereavement)
  • Life Assurance
  • Educational Assistance Program
  • Life-Style Account (D&B will match your contributions up to €40 per month and can be used to claim for a range of health-related, leisure or lifestyle activities)

    • At Dun & Bradstreet, we are 6,000 friendly colleagues around the world waiting to meet you and give you the opportunity to grow your career.

• Design, develop, test, deploy, and monitor scalable applications for data ingestion, mastering, matching, and publishing
  • Develop high-quality software using Java and Python, ensuring performance, maintainability, extensibility, and reliability.
  • Deliver end-to-end features across the software stack, operating with ownership of assigned components.
  • Build and maintain microservices and REST APIs, including real-time and streaming data capabilities.
  • Collaborate with solution architects and partner with lead architects to contribute to system design, reference architectures, and baseline implementations.
  • Contribute to platform modernization by simplifying, harmonizing, and optimizing systems to improve scalability and performance.
  • Validate solutions through proofs of concept and prototyping prior to full implementation.
  • Develop and optimize large-scale distributed data systems using modern frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, distributed processing technologies).
  • Collaborate with Data Science teams to implement advanced algorithms, models, and proprietary capabilities into production systems.
  • Ensure high availability, resilience, and performance of critical data processing systems (e.g., identity resolution/Match platforms).
  • Work cross-functionally with business stakeholders, QA, DevOps, and product teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, peer reviews, and adherence to development standards.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation, and modern engineering practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues using strong root cause analysis skills.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, information security, and regulatory standards.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related areas
  • At least 5 years of experience developing commercial software
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Python with solid object-oriented design principles
  • Experience building large-scale distributed systems and data platforms
  • Expertise in big data frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, EMR, Dataproc)
  • Advanced SQL and data modeling knowledge
  • Experience developing cloud-native solutions (AWS, GCP, or equivalent)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and high-availability systems
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating in cross-functional teams
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet
At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. The Solutions Consulting (SC) function is responsible for driving Dun & Bradstreet solutions in North America that address the unique challenges our customers face and align strategically to their core business and financial objectives to ensure strong economic value results from the partnership. The SC function starts after case assignment of a qualified sales-initiated opportunity to help sales move the opportunity forward. The goal is to: increase revenue; shorten the sales cycle; increase retention rates; increase brand awareness in the industry.

lists.content:
• Act as a trusted solutions advisor to sales teams and their clients, helping to understand the clients core needs/pain points, business, and technical requirements to recommend the most impactful approach leveraging the products in the assigned portfolio.

  • Consulting on the bigger picture versus just answering questions/RFPs.

  • Drive successful sales engagements and ensure our solutions align seamlessly with the client’s business objectives.

  • Work on prescriptive ROI models for the customer and where needed, assist in gathering client requirements and understanding their business needs.

  • Assist sales in develop solution proposals, outlining how our products can address specific challenges and add economic value to the client’s business.

  • Conduct engaging and persuasive executive/decision maker conversations/discussions to showcase the capabilities and benefits of our solutions; adapt conversations/presentations to different audiences and address specific use cases effectively; assist when sales presents on product demonstrations, when needed.

  • Collaborate with sales and client success when necessary to participate in strategic client meetings.

  • Work closely with all internal teams to ensure proper transfer of key business objectives to align to long term KPIs and broader success criteria the client is expecting from the partnership.

  • Effectively navigate the matrix, bringing in the proper experts as needed to support the client proposal (Solutions Architects, Analytic Advisors, Product, etc).

  • Continuously expand expertise in products and solutions, stay up to date with the latest advancements in the markets, industries, and verticals you support; share knowledge with the sales team, product team and other key stakeholders to enhance the collective understanding of our solutions; understand and articulate the differences in competitive solutions.

  • Be an industry expert; participate in industry events (conferences, trade shows, client events, etc) to support our positions as industry and thought leaders.

  • Collaborate with the Sales, Product and Marketing teams in creating sales collateral, solution documentation, and RFP responses; creating a continuous loop of ongoing sales training; working with sales and clients to identify potential opportunities for testimonials, white papers, and/or case studies; working with marketing, sales and clients in executing on the testimonials, white papers, and/or case studies; being the voice of customer for product improvements/feedback.

• Bachelors' degree with a minimum of 12 years prior experience in selling new solutions to clients and generating significant revenue growth, proven by a track record in a similar environment.

  • Experience selling data, technology and services preferred.

  • Proven experience as a SME, Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, Sales, Client Success, or Practitioner (risk manager, compliance, marketing, supply chain, vendor management, etc.).

  • Strong understanding of data architectures, software development principles, cloud computing, API’s, and IT Infrastructure.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical. audiences, including Executive level stakeholders. Strong management skills ensuring the opportunity progresses through the sales cycle.

  • Ability to build strong relationships with clients and internal teams, fostering a collaborative working environment.

  • Problem solving and analytical mindset capable of identifying and resolving technical challenges effectively.

  • Familiarity with relevant programming languages, databases, and enterprise software.

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholder, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings and industry events.

• Ability to sit, speak and operate telephone and/or computer for long periods of time

  • Ability to handle pressure, stressful conditions, and conflict resolution

  • Ability to work day, evening and/or weekend hours as needed

  • Ability to travel by any form of transportation, expected travel at least 25%

  • Regular attendance in the office

The SC function starts after case assignment of a qualified sales-initiated opportunity to help sales move the opportunity forward. The goal is to: increase revenue; shorten the sales cycle; increase retention rates; increase brand awareness in the industry.

lists.content:
• Act as a trusted solutions advisor to sales teams and their clients, helping to understand the clients core needs/pain points, business, and technical requirements to recommend the most impactful approach leveraging the products in the assigned portfolio.

  • Consulting on the bigger picture versus just answering questions/RFPs.

  • Drive successful sales engagements and ensure our solutions align seamlessly with the client’s business objectives.

  • Work on prescriptive ROI models for the customer and where needed, assist in gathering client requirements and understanding their business needs.

  • Assist sales in develop solution proposals, outlining how our products can address specific challenges and add economic value to the client’s business.

  • Conduct engaging and persuasive executive/decision maker conversations/discussions to showcase the capabilities and benefits of our solutions; adapt conversations/presentations to different audiences and address specific use cases effectively; assist when sales presents on product demonstrations, when needed.

  • Collaborate with sales and client success when necessary to participate in strategic client meetings.

  • Work closely with all internal teams to ensure proper transfer of key business objectives to align to long term KPIs and broader success criteria the client is expecting from the partnership.

  • Effectively navigate the matrix, bringing in the proper experts as needed to support the client proposal (Solutions Architects, Analytic Advisors, Product, etc).

  • Continuously expand expertise in products and solutions, stay up to date with the latest advancements in the markets, industries, and verticals you support; share knowledge with the sales team, product team and other key stakeholders to enhance the collective understanding of our solutions; understand and articulate the differences in competitive solutions.

  • Be an industry expert; participate in industry events (conferences, trade shows, client events, etc) to support our positions as industry and thought leaders.

  • Collaborate with the Sales, Product and Marketing teams in creating sales collateral, solution documentation, and RFP responses; creating a continuous loop of ongoing sales training; working with sales and clients to identify potential opportunities for testimonials, white papers, and/or case studies; working with marketing, sales and clients in executing on the testimonials, white papers, and/or case studies; being the voice of customer for product improvements/feedback.

• Bachelors' degree with a minimum of 12 years prior experience in selling new solutions to clients and generating significant revenue growth, proven by a track record in a similar environment.

  • Experience selling data, technology and services preferred.

  • Proven experience as a SME, Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, Sales, Client Success, or Practitioner (risk manager, compliance, marketing, supply chain, vendor management, etc.).

  • Strong understanding of data architectures, software development principles, cloud computing, API’s, and IT Infrastructure.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical. audiences, including Executive level stakeholders. Strong management skills ensuring the opportunity progresses through the sales cycle.

  • Ability to build strong relationships with clients and internal teams, fostering a collaborative working environment.

  • Problem solving and analytical mindset capable of identifying and resolving technical challenges effectively.

  • Familiarity with relevant programming languages, databases, and enterprise software.

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholder, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings and industry events.

• Ability to sit, speak and operate telephone and/or computer for long periods of time

  • Ability to handle pressure, stressful conditions, and conflict resolution

  • Ability to work day, evening and/or weekend hours as needed

  • Ability to travel by any form of transportation, expected travel at least 25%

  • Regular attendance in the office

The incumbent will independently drive Economic and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) engagements, ensuring methodological rigor, analytical excellence, and timely delivery. The role involves conducting primary and secondary research, performing quantitative and qualitative analysis, developing actionable insights, and preparing client-ready reports and presentations.

The individual will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, clients, policymakers, and industry participants to understand business requirements, provide evidence-based recommendations, and contribute to thought leadership initiatives that support client objectives and business growth.

 

Work Location: 4 days a week from the BKC, Mumbai office and 1 day a week from the Turbhe, Navi Mumbai office.

lists.content:
• Serve as the primary interface for internal sales teams and external stakeholders to drive growth in Economic Impact Assessment, Social Impact Assessment, CSR Impact Assessment, and Policy Evaluation services. Lead client discussions, identify and qualify opportunities, develop tailored proposals and methodologies, support solutioning, and convert prospects into long-term client engagements.
  • Lead the end-to-end execution of impact assessment mandates, including research design, data collection, stakeholder consultations, economic and social impact modelling, policy analysis, report writing, quality assurance, and client presentations. Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, insight-driven reports and actionable recommendations that meet client and stakeholder expectations.
  • Deliver in-depth macroeconomic and microeconomic analyses, offering a 360° perspective on India's growth trajectory, policy developments, and economic risks in a timely manner. Assess structural trends across key sectors such as agriculture, manufacturing, services, infrastructure, and the financial ecosystem, producing white papers and articles that offer unique insights.
  • Design and implement robust systems and models to forecast critical economic indicators, including GDP, inflation, trade balances, fiscal metrics, and sector-specific trends. Utilize advanced quantitative techniques to support predictive analytics and scenario building.
  • Leverage large datasets to uncover economic patterns and trends. Maintain, enhance, and validate complex economic databases, ensuring data integrity and accuracy to support analytical outputs.
  • Lead comprehensive sectoral studies covering rural consumption, production efficiencies, supply chain dynamics, credit flows, external trade, and financial market trends. Identify emerging risks and opportunities at both macro and micro levels.
  • Develop high-quality whitepapers, policy briefs, and opinion pieces that influence stakeholders across industries, financial institutions, and government bodies. Represent the group in internal & external forums, client briefings, media interactions, and time-critical insight requests, positioning the firm as a trusted voice on Indian economic matters.
  • Deliver timely, high-impact analyses on key economic events, data releases, and policy changes, ensuring that clients receive quick, responsive, and actionable insights.
  • Provide bespoke economic insights tailored to client needs, including risk assessments, investment analyses, and strategic recommendations. Engage directly with clients to present findings, address queries, and offer consultative expertise.

• Advanced degree in Economics (Master’s or Ph.D.) with a strong foundation in macroeconomics, econometrics, and quantitative analysis.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in economic research, policy analysis, consulting, or financial services, with a proven track record of delivering impactful economic insights on India and global economies.
  • Deep understanding of India's economic structure, including rural and urban consumption trends, production ecosystems, external trade dynamics, credit and lending markets, and financial sector regulations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex economic concepts into clear, concise, and compelling narratives for diverse audiences, including media engagements.
  • Strong client-facing capabilities with experience in presenting economic insights to senior stakeholders, policymakers, and industry leaders.

lists.content:
• Fulfill the role of trusted advisor on Dun & Bradstreet solutions through the development of strong, positive relationships with clients, through strategic conversations to understand organizational business objectives and goals.
  • Build senior level executive relationship with clients to achieve revenue growth.
  • Strong motivation and drive to work proactively to develop customer base both on existing as well as the defined prospect accounts
  • Maintain and grow revenue stream through successful renewal of existing business.
  • New account development and/or expanding existing accounts through cross-sell and up-sell of new opportunities within an established portfolio of clients working closely with Solutions Sales.
  • Carry out regular account management activity to “Protect” existing accounts. Proactively identify accounts at risk of churn and implement retention strategies.
  • End-to-end accountability for driving the negotiation, contracting, and approval processes.
  • Navigate complex deal management and negotiation including alignment of multiple decision makers, products or funding sources.
  • Perform account planning for assigned accounts, coordinating with internal sales resources to ensure strategic alignment.
  • Develop and maintain an active pipeline of forecasted sales to meet annual quota objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with all business initiatives
  • Maintain consistent and accurate data in relevant CRM software (e.g. SFDC) and other sales tools to support territory, account planning and forecasting.
  • Collaborate with Client Success and increase retention rates through business reviews and win-back campaigns.
  • Serve as a thought leader in the industry, staying up-to-date with market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote D&B's offerings.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

• Minimum of five (5) years prior experience in field sales, senior sales enterprise level SaaS, consulting or services sales role
  • Industry experience preferred – consulting or technology verticals
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Proven success in closing sales, winning clients, managing client relationships with portfolio of accounts and attaining or exceeding annual quota(s)
  • Ability to rapidly assess client environments from a business process, organizational and technological perspective, and effectively prioritize opportunities for growth
  • Demonstrable track record in managing complex strategic sales and managing multiple senior stakeholders
  • Ability to present to C suite audiences and experts on the client side.
  • Highly articulate with excellent business communication (verbal and written) skills and presentation skills suitable for a global corporate environment
  • Possesses excellent industry-leading sales methodology, relevant CRM software (e.g. SFDC) and Microsoft Office Suite skills.
  • Able and willing to mentor and support other members of the team
  • Fluency in English and Norwegian is required for this role

The Technical Product Owner serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, owning the definition, prioritisation, and delivery of technically complex initiatives.


This role focuses on AI enabled platforms, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and secure enterprise systems, translating business goals into clear, actionable product requirements and ensuring high quality delivery through agile practices.
The TPO works closely with product leadership, engineering, architecture, security, and platform teams to drive delivery across AI use cases, data platforms, cloud environments, and application ecosystems.

lists.text: What’s on Offer at D&B Ireland
lists.content:
• 25 days annual leave (plus 2 paid volunteer days & 1 paid un-sick day)
  • Holiday buy & sell (the option to buy or sell up to 5 additional days per year)
  • Flexible working - hybrid model
  • Employee Health Insurance
  • Mental Health Support program
  • Pension Contribution
  • Family Friendly Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Parental, Marriage and Bereavement)
  • Life Assurance
  • Educational Assistance Program
  • Life-Style Account (D&B will match your contributions up to €40 per month and can be used to claim for a range of health-related, leisure or lifestyle activities)

    • At Dun & Bradstreet, we are 6,000 friendly colleagues around the world waiting to meet you and give you the opportunity to grow your career.

• Elicit, analyse, and document business, functional, and technical requirements across AI, platform, and cloud‑based initiatives.

  • Translate stakeholder and customer needs into well‑defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritised backlog items.

  • Own and manage the product backlog in Jira, ensuring stories are technically clear, groomed, and delivery‑ready.

  • Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the sprint lifecycle—from refinement and planning through delivery and review.

  • Support and actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Engage in technical discussions to support story refinement, dependency management, issue triage, and delivery decisions.

  • Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, and security standards.

  • Support delivery of AI‑driven capabilities, including data access, model integration, observability, and governance considerations.

  • Continuously adapt to new platforms, tools, and technical domains, driving ongoing improvement in delivery and product clarity.

• Hands‑on experience working in Agile environments, with practical exposure to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery workflows.

  • Ability to balance business priorities with technical feasibility and delivery constraints.

  • Proven experience using Jira for backlog management, requirement tracking, and delivery coordination.

  • Strong capability in writing clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing dependencies.

  • Prior experience in roles such as Technical Product Owner, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar delivery‑focused positions.

    • Experience working in technology‑driven, engineering‑led environments.

    • Comfort operating across system‑centric, platform, and infrastructure contexts rather than purely functional domains.

    • Ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into structured, actionable technical requirements.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

      • Willingness to learn and engage with new technologies, platforms, and architectural patterns.

      • Openness to working across AI, data, cloud, and infrastructure‑heavy use cases.

      • Experience working on or supporting AI‑enabled products, data platforms, or intelligent systems.

      • Familiarity with concepts such as data pipelines, model integration, AI governance, or observability is an advantage.

        • Understanding of cloud concepts such as environments, deployments, networking, and infrastructure‑as‑code.

        • Exposure to GCP, AWS, or Azure; GCP experience is desirable but not mandatory.

        • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Harness or similar tools) and modern delivery practices.

        • Ability to work with engineering teams to align delivery processes with product goals.

          • Basic understanding of application security, access control, data protection, and governance considerations.

          • Ability to incorporate security and compliance requirements into product and platform stories.

          • Previous exposure to product ownership, platform products, or internal developer platforms is a strong advantage.

          • Ability to think beyond delivery and contribute to product quality, scalability, and long‑term value.

            • Highly structured and detail‑oriented, with a strong focus on clarity and quality.

            • Comfortable working across multiple workstreams, platforms, and technical domains.

            • Collaborative, proactive, and delivery‑focused, with a strong sense of ownership.

            • Confident engaging with technical teams while maintaining a clear business and customer perspective.

lists.content:
• Drive the overall implementation of integrated products or connectors, in individually owned projects/cases or, as part of larger projects in collaboration with Customer Project Managers.

• Experience in project work, consulting/leading and/or project management
  • 1– 3 years’ experience in a direct customer facing role

  • Experience working with integrated products and/or integration platforms

  • Data-driven problem-solver
  • Knowledge of AI technologies, such as MCP, ARD, ARA, A2A
  • Customer-centric, especially working with multiple simultaneous customer assignments
  • Ability to simplify technical issues, and teach and guide others with their technical development, especially around integrated products/services

lists.content:

The Vice President, Enterprise Risk is a senior enterprise leader who advances a strong, transparent risk culture across Dun & Bradstreet. This role partners across the business to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate material risks within the company’s risk appetite, spanning strategic, operational, technology, cyber, data, financial, international, reputational, and compliance dimensions.

The role combines deep enterprise risk expertise with strong business judgment, executive communication, and change leadership to strengthen resilience, support growth, and protect Dun & Bradstreet’s legacy of integrity and trust.

lists.content:
• Lead the global Enterprise Risk program, including risk identification, assessment, prioritization, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting across the enterprise.

  • Lead the global Business Continuity Management program and help drive enterprise operational resilience planning, testing, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as deputy leader for enterprise crisis management, helping coordinate governance, response readiness, scenario planning, and post-event lessons learned.

  • Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Data, Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, HR, Strategy, Operations, and International teams to assess and address risks arising from business transformation, acquisitions, product innovation, regulatory change, and market evolution.

  • Oversee the enterprise risk register, key risk indicators, emerging risk processes, and executive reporting for the Enterprise Risk Committee, Board of Directors, and other senior leadership forums.

  • Advance the use of modern AI tools, automation, analytics, and risk platforms to mature and accelerate enterprise risk capabilities, improve insight generation, strengthen monitoring, and increase team efficiency.

  • Help shape and coordinate governance for AI and other emerging technologies, including risks related to model use, data quality, regulatory change, third-party dependency, and operational adoption.

  • Define and enhance risk methodologies, taxonomies, scenarios, and reporting frameworks to better support strategic decision-making and board-level transparency.

• Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field. MBA is preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience in Enterprise Risk Management or a similar role.

  • Strong executive presence, leadership, and influence skills, with the ability to engage effectively across senior leadership, boards, and cross-functional teams.

  • Collaborative, proactive, and outcome-oriented approach, with the ability to challenge constructively and build alignment in a complex global environment.

  • Deep knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management principles, governance, and operating models.

  • Strong understanding of technology, data, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and customer-facing business operations.

  • Demonstrated experience with business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, and operational resilience.

  • Business acumen with understanding of the data, analytics, and decisioning industry, including changing market and regulatory conditions.

  • Ability to leverage modern AI tools and platforms responsibly to improve insight generation, productivity, decision support, and risk program maturity.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, change management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex risk issues into practical business actions.

  • Practical understanding of enterprise processes, including product delivery, client-facing commercial functions, client service, and relevant regulatory obligations.

  • Working knowledge of financial, accounting, audit, fraud, and regulatory risk considerations.

  • Ability to anticipate and manage disruptive and unexpected events that could materially affect the company’s operations, reputation, or strategic objectives.

  • Knowledge of recognized business continuity and resilience standards, including ISO 22301, and experience implementing and maintaining effective continuity plans, processes, and testing routines.

  • Understanding of talent, organizational, and capability-related risks, including retention, succession, and critical skill gaps in a changing business and technology environment.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, data governance, and third-party risk considerations associated with modern digital platforms and emerging technologies.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

The Vice President, Enterprise Risk is a senior enterprise leader who advances a strong, transparent risk culture across Dun & Bradstreet. This role partners across the business to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate material risks within the company’s risk appetite, spanning strategic, operational, technology, cyber, data, financial, international, reputational, and compliance dimensions.

The role combines deep enterprise risk expertise with strong business judgment, executive communication, and change leadership to strengthen resilience, support growth, and protect Dun & Bradstreet’s legacy of integrity and trust.

lists.content:
• Lead the global Enterprise Risk program, including risk identification, assessment, prioritization, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting across the enterprise.

  • Lead the global Business Continuity Management program and help drive enterprise operational resilience planning, testing, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as deputy leader for enterprise crisis management, helping coordinate governance, response readiness, scenario planning, and post-event lessons learned.

  • Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Data, Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, HR, Strategy, Operations, and International teams to assess and address risks arising from business transformation, acquisitions, product innovation, regulatory change, and market evolution.

  • Oversee the enterprise risk register, key risk indicators, emerging risk processes, and executive reporting for the Enterprise Risk Committee, Board of Directors, and other senior leadership forums.

  • Advance the use of modern AI tools, automation, analytics, and risk platforms to mature and accelerate enterprise risk capabilities, improve insight generation, strengthen monitoring, and increase team efficiency.

  • Help shape and coordinate governance for AI and other emerging technologies, including risks related to model use, data quality, regulatory change, third-party dependency, and operational adoption.

  • Define and enhance risk methodologies, taxonomies, scenarios, and reporting frameworks to better support strategic decision-making and board-level transparency.

• Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field. MBA is preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience in Enterprise Risk Management or a similar role.

  • Strong executive presence, leadership, and influence skills, with the ability to engage effectively across senior leadership, boards, and cross-functional teams.

  • Collaborative, proactive, and outcome-oriented approach, with the ability to challenge constructively and build alignment in a complex global environment.

  • Deep knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management principles, governance, and operating models.

  • Strong understanding of technology, data, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and customer-facing business operations.

  • Demonstrated experience with business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, and operational resilience.

  • Business acumen with understanding of the data, analytics, and decisioning industry, including changing market and regulatory conditions.

  • Ability to leverage modern AI tools and platforms responsibly to improve insight generation, productivity, decision support, and risk program maturity.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, change management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex risk issues into practical business actions.

  • Practical understanding of enterprise processes, including product delivery, client-facing commercial functions, client service, and relevant regulatory obligations.

  • Working knowledge of financial, accounting, audit, fraud, and regulatory risk considerations.

  • Ability to anticipate and manage disruptive and unexpected events that could materially affect the company’s operations, reputation, or strategic objectives.

  • Knowledge of recognized business continuity and resilience standards, including ISO 22301, and experience implementing and maintaining effective continuity plans, processes, and testing routines.

  • Understanding of talent, organizational, and capability-related risks, including retention, succession, and critical skill gaps in a changing business and technology environment.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, data governance, and third-party risk considerations associated with modern digital platforms and emerging technologies.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites Skills

  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.
