This position can be based in Jacksonville, Florida (USA), London (UK), Dublin (Ireland), or Hyderabad (India). Candidates must have the legal right to work in the country where they are applying. 
 
The Role:
The Vice President, Revenue and Expense Process and AI is responsible for the technology, operations and strategy for the ERP platforms that underpin our Global Business. This role leads cross-functional teams to modernise and simplify these processes including how we align all our Global markets onto a unified set of platform and standardized processes. This will be a transformative role which is responsible for the simplification of end-to-end processes and introducing new technologies to improve efficiency, scalability and control across the organization. This role will be heavily focused on the Workday platform and must be expert in the utilisation of Workday as it will serve as the primary point of contact & leadership within D&B.
 
Alongside this, the professional should be a champion for AI innovation and adoption within the Finance department, partnering with the Finance team on opportunities for where advances in AI could be utilised. This will require the candidate to develop an AI strategy for Finance along with a pragmatic adoption process.

lists.content:
• Leads Financial systems team, accountable for systems operations, maintenance, reporting and integration – the primary focus is the ERP platforms including Workday. Also leads Financial systems strategy, operating model design and implementation support. Leads, partners and works with external consultants on significant enterprise-wide projects.
  • Serves as key member of the Finance leadership team, playing a significant role in the implementation, evaluation, optimization and on-going support of Workday Financial ERP system and related systems within the Finance department. Acts as liaison between the Finance and D&B Technology teams.
  • Drives transformation of business processes, the finance operating model, technology, security and data/integrity.
  • Oversees system configuration management and routine updates, partnering with Finance leadership to implement related changes to our platforms and Business processes.
  • Works closely with decision makers across departments to identify, recommend, develop, implement and support cost-effective Workday / Financial systems designs and solutions that impact the Finance organization.
  • Develop and maintain high level of knowledge of Workday Financial and Financial systems modules, accounting transactions and accounting flows as necessary to understand the impacts to financial reporting. Leads, drives and refines Workday and Financial systems where needed to support existing and new reporting requirements while maintaining reporting continuity with minimal disruptions.
  • Develop the strategy for AI usage within the Finance department, investigating new technologies and products that could offer advantages to D&B. These should be driven through investigation, trial and adoption. This role is the key for evangelizing the usage and implementation of AI in Finance processes.
  • Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing Finance System team, fostering a culture of excellence, operational rigor, and continuous improvement
  • Own system stability, change management, incident response, and SOX/audit readiness.
  • Establish KPIs, SLAs, and performance dashboards focused on operational performance, reliability, data quality and process throughput.
  • Manages configuration set-ups in the various Financial systems (Workday Financials, etc.) Project manages Financial systems initiatives (including Workday upgrades), provides for assistance required from other IT/business groups, including follow up and create/monitor test plans to achieve the goals.

• 12 to 15 years of relevant Finance hands-on functional experience. 10+ years’ experience leading Finance workstreams, program management and systems transformation implementations.
  • Workday Financials Professional certification
  • A minimum of one full life cycle Workday Financial implementation
  • Proficiency in multiple Finance business processes: Pro Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), General Ledger (GL), Fixed Asset Management (FA), Budgeting, Cash Management, Purchase Order Conversions, Expense Management and Sales Revenue Accounting
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems / Computer Science or equivalent professional experience
  • Other leading Cloud based financial application implementation experience (ie: Oracle, SAP, Lawson)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
  • Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

lists.content:
• Office workplace representative & customer point of contact, covering the Front of House as required.
  • Support Reception Services – meet and greet as you will be welcoming guests and visitors, provide support manage their enquiries in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Site Safety and Security – championing site rules and being the point of contact for all safety and security enquiries.
  • Facilities Administration – maintaining records, site notices, processing invoicing, assisting in organising the facilities elements of any office events and other administration relating to facilities matters in a proactive manner.
  • Office maintenance: Understand the works Standard Operation Procedure to manage preventive and reactive requests and mitigate / avoid any impact to our customers.
  • Coordinate cleaning requests, ensuring high quality of works to achieve pristine standards.  
  • Coordinating catering, incoming & outgoing mail, any other 3rd party office services, stock control as required
  • Coordinate the facilities services, proactively showing a strong problem-solving ability approach to promote high level satisfaction to all our team members and customers.
  • Managing and prioritizing tasks and queries as part of the day-to-day role, working closely with the front end and facility manager.
  • Communicate in an open, honest, and transparent manner at all times with the ability to tailor the messages to a specific audience and their needs.
  • Cover the Workplace Manager in times of absenteeism, and busy periods.

• Experience in a similar environment.
  • Understanding of Health & Safety Regulations and compliance
  • Excellent customer service, planning and organisational skills.
  • Ability to respond fast and priorities work in an efficient manner.
  • Team player with a proactive outlook and ability to multitasks, while working independently
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact and communicate effectively.
  • Energetic, approachable, and representative of D&B, ensuring our customers and visitors feel welcome.
  • Excellent PC and administration skills, with good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Good level of written and verbal communication skills, able to communicate at all levels (Polish & English)
  • Ability to always adhere to site rules and regulations.
